verdict.rationale: Automations are a fair axis for a cloud file-storage product, but the evidence pack documents no OneDrive feature for creating autonomous background automations such as rules, flows, or scheduled tasks. Microsoft Graph change notifications and delta queries are developer building blocks someone could use to build automations. Folder backup is an adjacent background sync behavior, not a user-defined automation, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
